topic: ChatGPT adds virtual try-on: see clothes and accessories on yourself before you buy
details: news; launched early Oct 2026 globally, mobile + web; Try On button in shopping results, upload selfie/full-body photo; uses ChatGPT Images; also Favorites; reference photos saved; AI preview can't confirm fit
subject: ChatGPT adds virtual try-on: see clothes and accessories on yourself before you buy
audience: online clothes shoppers and ChatGPT users who buy fashion on their phone
core_value: how the new try-on works, and that it shows the look but not the fit, and saves your selfie
desired_action: comment: would you trust a selfie over a size chart
tone: calm reporting; the catches are OpenAI's own words, not alarm
footage_constraints: no official demo video. OpenAI official stills (try-on flow, Favorites) via TechCrunch; mobile captures of OpenAI help pages and TechCrunch. ChatGPT is not on the iOS Simulator. Optional: user's own screen recording of the feature.
